How your data moves through the lab

One pipeline, four checkpoints. Every item is annotated twice, reconciled, and audited before it reaches your dataset.

Step 0 — Free Calibration Trial

Send us up to 100 items and your labeling schema. We staff a pod, run the full pipeline below, and hand back finished data — free — so you can judge our accuracy and turnaround before committing.

$0 · No commitment required
Step 1 Schema & Pod Setup

We translate your guidelines into a working schema, then recruit and train a labeling pod matched to your task — NLP, vision, audio, or conversational RLHF.

Step 2 Dual-Annotator Pass

Every item is labeled independently by two trained annotators. Disagreements are flagged automatically rather than silently averaged away.

Step 3 Lead QA Audit

A senior QA lead reconciles disagreements, spot-audits consensus items, and resolves edge cases against your guidelines before anything is marked done.

Step 4 Delivery & Iteration

Clean, ground-truth data lands in your pipeline on a cadence you set. Feedback loops back to the pod so quality compounds batch over batch.

What we label

One managed team, every modality your roadmap needs.

TEXT & NLP

Text & NLP Annotation

Entity extraction, classification, sentiment, intent, summarization quality, and custom taxonomies.

ALIGNMENT

RLHF & Model Alignment

Response ranking, preference pairs, red-teaming, and reward-model calibration for chat and agentic models.

VISION

Image & Video Labeling

Bounding boxes, segmentation, keypoints, and frame-level classification for CV and multimodal models.

SPEECH

Audio & Speech Annotation

Transcription, diarization, intent tagging, and quality scoring for speech and voice-agent training data.

TRUST & SAFETY

Content Moderation & Safety Review

Policy-based content review, harmful-content detection, and safety-tuned RLHF datasets.

EVALUATION

Search & Ranking Evaluation

Relevance judgments, side-by-side model comparisons, and structured human evaluation at scale.

Questions founders ask

If yours isn't here, ask us directly — a real person answers.

How does the free 100-item trial work?+

Send us your schema and up to 100 sample items. We run them through our full dual-annotator + Lead QA pipeline and deliver labeled data back to you — free, with no commitment or credit card required.

How is Distinction Lab priced?+

Pricing is quoted per project based on volume, task complexity, and turnaround needs — not a flat per-seat SaaS fee. There are no hidden platform markups or high enterprise minimums, so cost scales with what you actually need.

How do you protect our data?+

All engagements are covered by NDA before we see a single sample. Access to your data is limited to the pod assigned to your project, and we can work within your security and compliance requirements.

What's your typical turnaround time?+

Turnaround depends on task complexity and volume, and is agreed upfront for every batch. Your trial batch will give you a real, task-specific benchmark before you commit to an ongoing cadence.

Do we need a minimum volume to work with you?+

No. We're built for startups and SMEs specifically, so there's no high-volume enterprise minimum. Pods scale up or down as your data needs change.
